# Tony Wu (Wu Tianzhuo, 吴天卓)

> Personal site of Tony Wu (Wu Tianzhuo, 吴天卓), a product manager and full-stack AI engineer based in Singapore. Software engineer at SendOS; graduate student (Systems Analysis) at the National University of Singapore. Focus: AI products, RAG knowledge platforms and AI agents. Not to be confused with AI researcher Yuhuai (Tony) Wu or Hong Kong actor Tony Wu Tsz-tung.

Key facts:
- Name: Tony Wu; Chinese name 吴天卓 (pinyin Wu Tianzhuo); from China, based in Singapore
- Current: Software Engineer, SendOS (Sep 2026 – present), Singapore
- Education: National University of Singapore, Graduate Diploma in Systems Analysis (2026 – present); Zhejiang University of Technology, B.Eng. Software Engineering (2022 – 2026)
- Previous: Full-Stack AI Engineer, Saizhi Technology, Hangzhou (Mar – May 2026): agent-based RAG knowledge platform with hybrid BM25 + vector + LLM reranking, 96% answer accuracy
- Previous: Product Manager, Hangzhou Zhiliaosiyuan (Apr 2024 – Jan 2025): checkout redesign lifted payment conversion ~6%
- Open source: 40+ merged pull requests, including rea, claude-mem, grpc-gateway, SurfSense and isomorphic-git
- Award: Second Prize, Zhejiang Provincial Cybersecurity Competition
- Languages: Mandarin, English
- Contact: tonywu.vip@outlook.com

## Projects

- [CampusLink](https://github.com/t2047/CampusLink): NUS team project, an AI campus workspace with a human-confirmed chat agent; Tony was product manager and built the mail and calendar module
- [AI Wellness Mobile App](https://github.com/TonyWu2333/AI-Wellness-Mobile-App): Android wellness assistant backed by a RAG agent over a medical knowledge base; Tony maintains the repo
